notes: Draft evidence contract only. A phase string cannot satisfy a transition gate. Operative F1 requires one content-addressed F0→F1 transition. Operative F2 requires both that validated prior F0→F1 record and a current F1→F2 record whose approved payload binds the prior transition digest, so F2 cannot be entered directly from F0. Active-Member thresholds are evaluated from reconstructable Membership history as of the target phase-effective date, while delegation gates count only delegations effective and unexpired on that date.
